unverified.title: King County Superior Court: no race on your ballot
unverified.text: No King County Superior Court position appears in the Secretary of State's list of ballot items for the 2026 primary or general election (checked 2026-10-17). That is expected under state law: the Secretary of State's judicial elections guidance says that "an uncontested Superior Court race in a county with a population of 100,000 or more is not printed on the ballot; instead, the candidate is issued a certificate of election following the last day for candidates to withdraw" (WA Const. Art. IV § 29). So any Superior Court judge who drew no opponent this year was elected without appearing on the ballot, and voters have no Superior Court choice to make. Judges recently appointed to King County Superior Court, per the Governor's list, include Kent Liu (June 4, 2025), Daniel York (Jan. 13, 2026), Tenaya Scheinman (Apr. 15, 2026) and Jessica Murphy Manca (June 8, 2026). Which of their seats were up this year was not confirmed, so this page does not include cards for them.
